stories.title: Dozens of rental bans issued at ‘horrible’ Dublin flat complex
stories.details: Buckingham Village, a north inner-city flat complex, has received more warning notices than any other development in Dublin. Residents face severe issues including pitch-dark hallways and various obstructions, leading to the complex being described as a slum.

stories.title: Buckingham Village: From regeneration to slum
stories.details: Once intended to reinvigorate Dublin’s inner city, Buckingham Village has deteriorated significantly by 2022. The complex is now the subject of intense scrutiny due to its poor living conditions and high volume of regulatory warnings.

stories.title: Manchester City guilty of nearly all 115 Premier League charges
stories.details: Manchester City has been found guilty of nearly all 115 charges brought by the Premier League. Potential sanctions for the club range from heavy fines to expulsion from the league or relegation.

stories.title: Tuchel warns Palmer about ‘missing way too many’ England camps
stories.details: England manager Thomas Tuchel has publicly criticized Cole Palmer for missing too many international training camps. The comments highlight tensions regarding player availability and commitment to the national squad.

stories.title: Will Spain bring more pain for Tuchel and England?
stories.details: Following a disappointing summer, England faces world champions Spain in the Nations League. Thomas Tuchel remains under pressure to prove his tactical approach can overcome elite opposition after recent failures.

stories.title: Barnet manager Dean Brennan eyes Dele Alli signing
stories.details: League Two side Barnet is interested in signing Dele Alli, who has been training at the club's Hive Stadium. Manager Dean Brennan expressed enthusiasm for the move, noting that the former Spurs star still possesses special quality.

stories.title: João Mário dismisses Ronaldo-Fernandes handshake controversy
stories.details: João Mário has clarified that an awkward handshake between Cristiano Ronaldo and Bruno Fernandes was merely a joke between teammates. He insisted that the two players maintain a great relationship despite external speculation.

stories.title: Gianni Infantino calls for ceasefire during Qatar World Cup
stories.details: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has urged G20 leaders to support a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine for the duration of the 2022 World Cup. The proposal has been met with skepticism given FIFA's previous stance on keeping politics out of football.

stories.title: Philipp Lahm criticizes Qatar World Cup hosting
stories.details: World Cup-winning captain Philipp Lahm has stated that awarding the tournament to Qatar was a mistake. He confirmed he will not be attending the event, citing concerns over the host nation's suitability.

stories.title: Israel’s Saied Abu Farchi sent off for goal celebration
stories.details: Israel forward Saied Abu Farchi received a red card following his goal celebration during a 3-1 Nations League defeat to Austria. The incident has drawn attention to the strict enforcement of celebration rules in international fixtures.

stories.title: Brazil and Australia draw 1-1 in Nations League
stories.details: Brazil and Australia played out a 1-1 draw in North Queensland. Bournemouth's Rayan scored a 95th-minute equalizer for Brazil after Nestory Irankunda had put the Socceroos ahead with a free-kick.

stories.title: Angela Rayner discusses migration policy
stories.details: Home Secretary Angela Rayner has addressed the government's migration policy in a new interview. Despite her previous cabinet resignation, she remains a central figure in the current administration's legislative agenda.

stories.title: North Korean soldiers defect to South Korea
stories.details: Two North Korean soldiers who were captured by Ukrainian forces while fighting for Russia have defected to South Korea. The case highlights the complex global nature of the ongoing conflict in Europe.

stories.title: Tony Blair calls for Strait of Hormuz cooperation
stories.details: Former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair has urged European nations to step up efforts to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz. He emphasized the need for international cooperation to secure global shipping routes.

stories.title: Protests erupt during Netanyahu’s UN speech
stories.details: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faced mass protests and a walkout of delegates during his address to the UN General Assembly. Over 100 people were arrested outside the headquarters during the demonstrations.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils new Copilot super app
stories.details: Microsoft has launched an all-in-one Copilot app that integrates AI chat, coding, and autonomous agents. The app allows users to switch between models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Microsoft, with a new tiered pricing structure.

stories.title: KPMG announces tech staff cuts
stories.details: KPMG is reshaping its advisory arm, resulting in job cuts across its AI, Cyber, SAP, and Testing teams. Affected staff have criticized the severance packages offered by the consultancy firm.

stories.title: Salesforce Agentforce vulnerabilities exposed
stories.details: Security researchers have identified 'SalesBleed' flaws in Salesforce's Agentforce, which could allow for 0-click CRM data theft and anonymous phishing. The company is working to address the security risks.

stories.title: Anthropic supports OpenAI’s markdown instructions
stories.details: Anthropic has decided to adopt OpenAI’s markdown instructions specification. The move is expected to resolve long-standing compatibility issues for developers working across different AI platforms.

stories.title: David Beckham takes £39m dividend from business empire
stories.details: David Beckham has received a £39 million dividend from his business ventures. The profits were largely driven by a series of high-profile brand deals linked to the World Cup.

stories.title: Aran Island goats hired for biodiversity
stories.details: An agricultural scheme on the Aran Islands is paying farmers to use goats for targeted grazing. The initiative aims to combat nuisance plants and protect local wildflower biodiversity.

stories.title: El Niño threatens global transport and food supply
stories.details: Experts warn that a monster El Niño could cause widespread disruption, including transport chaos and poor crop yields. The phenomenon is expected to impact global logistics and food security.

stories.title: Drones to speed up cardiac arrest response
stories.details: A new study suggests that using drones to deliver defibrillators could significantly improve survival rates for cardiac arrest patients. The technology aims to reduce response times in emergency situations.
